datum.note: housing height is measured from the finished floor, never from the plinth top, never inherited

filler.reason: the Sub-Zero hinge draws the panel inward as the door opens

void.note: 84in is the American standard; anything above it needs a proposed solution. The threshold was 70 until 2026-08-25: at 70 a Classic standard opening left 73 mm and the tool offered an open shelf 73 mm tall, which is not a shelf.

run_gap.top: the appliance where it publishes a height, otherwise the section top
run_gap.depth: the run's own depth, measured from the unit beside the gap - never a constant
run_gap.holds: the appliance itself, and nothing at all until one is named
run_gap.when_unassigned: RESERVED - client-supplied machine, the division is NOT decided
run_gap.top_note: Height is the section top: the guide publishes a width and nothing else
run_gap.proud_note: The reservation stops at the worktop - a pro range's body may stand proud of it
run_gap.drawn_by: the engine. The extent is a fact about the RUN, and a run gap exists only inside a run
run_gap.note: B6. A range stands in a gap in the run, not in an opening, so the guide prints a width and nothing else. Before this it was skipped and the span was marked by nothing.

installation.pro_series: ask, no default (its standard/flush pair is not about panels)
installation.source: subzero-design-guide.pdf rev 4/2026 p.11 - flush inset is available for overlay models only

remedies.what: flush-fitted end cap, used when the grip recess is aligned with a dishwasher
flush-fitted end cap where the recess meets a base or tall side panel, RH and LH
Grip Edgings FRAME / STEP / 30 deg on the panel itself, included in the door price

gola.servo_flex: required for a fridge tall unit with fixed hinges when there is no handle and no grip recess

consequences_of_22mm: 90 degree door stop may be required for flush inset thicker than 19
dispenser models CL4250SD and CL4850SD need the panel routed in the dispenser area
weight limits: 34 kg for CL3650R(ID)/RG/F and CL3050W, 23 kg all other models, 6 kg grille

sections.worktop: sits on top of the carcass
sections.plinth_source: registry/cesar - plinth_h_mm is a family fact

colour.meaning: red marks what still needs a decision
